messages:
ivy: :rotating_light: Root: Were seeing elevated 500s and long cold-start times for model compilation endpoints on Dedicated clusters in us-west-2. First alerts ~03:15 UTC. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2109999999

compile-bot: Alert: model-compile-500-rate spike detected on usw2-compile-pool (threshold=0.5%). Autopage: @diego @anika.

diego: Triage summary: checksum failures during artifact read from the compile-cache shard (s3-compatible store). Partial/failed writes during a maintenance window left some cached artifacts with truncated manifests; loader aborts with checksum mismatch causing immediate 500 for compile requests that hit those artifacts.

anika: Mitigations applied at 03:22 UTC: 1) disabled compile-cache reads for us-west-2 so builds fall back to remote incremental compile (adds latency but avoids 500s), 2) purged suspect shard keys prefixed comp-cache/usw2/shard-7, 3) throttled on-demand compile concurrency to 10 for the region while we validate.

ops-bot: Ops commands used (internal):

```
# purge suspect shard keys (ops only)
aws s3 rm s3://compile-cache-usw2/comp-cache/shard-7 --recursive --exclude "*verified*"
# toggle cache read flag
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.ai/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" -d '{"flag":"compile.cache_reads","region":"usw2","enabled":false}'
```

sre: Impact: customers launching new large-model endpoints may see increased cold-start latency (~10-60s) while compilation falls back to remote, and a transient 500 rate peaked at ~0.84% for the region. Existing running deployments unaffected. No data corruption beyond the cached artifacts.

cs: Customer comms drafted: "We detected intermittent compile failures and slow cold-starts in us-west-2 due to a corrupted compile cache shard. We have disabled cache reads and purged affected keys; services are healthy with higher cold-start latency. We will follow up with a postmortem and remediation timeline." Ready to send to impacted accounts once we confirm 30m stability.

diego: Next actions: 1) add atomic/transactional upload to compile-cache (two-phase commit + verified marker), 2) add checksum-mismatch alerting and auto-purge policy, 3) run a background job to verify all shard keys and rehydrate from S3 if corrupted. Postmortem owners: @diego (root cause + fix) and @anika (mitigation + comms). ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow.

compile-bot: Severity downgraded to S3 at 03:40 UTC after cache-read disable and purges; monitoring active.

ivy: Thanks team  continue monitoring and update #customer-success if any high-touch accounts report regressions. End of broadcast. :white_check_mark:
